title: Fatma A Possible NDE 8560
content: This experience happened in the middle of the night. I had been sleeping. My husband and I were sleeping in our double bed. During the night I woke up, thinking of going to the bathroom. As I arose, I looked down upon the bed and there was a women sleeping beside my husband. That women looked exactly like me. A carbon copy! I got scared and thought, 'But that can't be me. Who is that?' Suddenly, I felt a presence nearby, seeming to be about three feet away from me. I turned to look and there was a man standing near the window. He was about six and a half feet (two meters) tall. His silver hair was combed back in a ponytail. He had blue eyes. His face was pale white, silky smooth, and had a shine to it, reminiscent of the moon. He had no mustache nor beard. His clothes were all white—simple and neat. The man did not look scary to me at first. But after looking at him for a moment, I got scared. I found I could not speak from my mouth, but WAS able to communicate with him from my brain. So I asked him, 'Who are you?' I got no reply. I asked him two more times, 'Who are you?' He finally replied, 'I am Allah's Angel and I have been sent to take your soul because you are dead now.' I replied, 'No, I am NOT dead. Look, I am standing here with you.' And the Angel said, 'Yes, you ARE dead. See? There is your dead body lying right there on the bed.' I told the Angel, 'No, it's not. That is a Jinn (spirit) lying beside my husband. It has simply taken my form.' But the Angel replied, 'No, that body lying beside your husband is YOUR dead body and the 'YOU' standing here is your soul.' At that point, I started believing him and having sad feelings because I would have to leave my husband and my three sleeping children. The Angel gently held my hand and we floated out through the window. The feeling of sadness vanished as we moved upwards towards the sky. Looking downwards, I saw the roof of my house and then the other houses on my street. As we continued to move upwards into the sky, I saw everything getting smaller and smaller, and it all looked so beautiful. At first, the earth looked flat to me. But the further up we went into space, the more the earth appeared oval shaped. Then looking around, I saw we were passing planets, stars and many galaxies. They looked very beautiful. I seemed to be going somewhere very, very far away, but in a short span of time. I suddenly jerked and I wasn't there any more. When I opened my eyes, I was in an incredibly beautiful, amazing garden that I cannot find words to describe. I was standing in this garden next to a huge gold and silver gate with many decorative shiny gems of different colours. The Angel who was with me now stood on the other side of the gate. He said, 'You cannot leave this garden. This garden is your place and you have to stay here until Judgment Day.' I said to him, 'Take me back to my family NOW. My children are small and they will need me.' I told the Angel to speak to Allah, and plead with him— 'Allah, my Lord, please! No matter what, you MUST send me back!' The Angel did not reply to me; he just disappeared. Then I felt like touring the garden. Looking around, I saw a massive pathway leading to many smaller paths. The ground sparkled with white sand. I didn't see any grass. There were many trees that were blossoming in different colours and putting forth lovely musical melodies. Flowers emanated their own light. I had never seen anything like this scene on earth. I picked up a handful of the white sand and threw it up in the air. It gave off golden sparkles and then disappeared! I saw beautiful birds of different sizes, shapes, and colours. As I watched the birds in flight, I saw light sparkling and glittering from their wings. And their bird calls sounded like beautiful melodies! The sky was a peach colour. There were no clouds, no sun, moon, nor stars. The weather was perfect, calming, peaceful and just pure happiness. The place felt like I belonged there and I thought 'This is my home.' I walked up a path and came to a river where it divided into two forks. One fork was the colour of milk and the other fork was honey colored. There were trees that had massive fruits such as figs, apples, and grapes. Also, there were many different types of fruit that I didn't have names for, as I had never seen them on earth. As I was walking along the path, I approached some tall flowering plants. I moved the flowers aside to see what was behind them. There I beheld a huge, massive palace with shiny pearl domes. Its bricks were transparent, yet glowing with a silvery gold color, and there were beautifully colored gems interspersed among the bricks. The palace glowed with a mighty golden colour and it had emerald green doors. I walked towards those doors and they opened automatically for me, so I entered the palace. The carpets were silky green with a sequence of beautiful designs. I saw two golden thrones, decorated with green emeralds, red rubies and silver. There were also lovely red silk chairs glittering with beautiful gems. Also, there were sparkling, swinging chairs of green and silver. I was going around, touching everything and feeling so excited and so happy. I notice that I was dressed in a peach-pink silk dress with pearls and diamonds. I was wearing golden shoes, accented with pearls. I gazed around the interior of the palace and saw many doors. I opened one of the doors and found myself in a huge bathroom made of shiny, cream-colored marble. The bathtub was round, with water in it and it was full of floating lotus flowers. I also saw a beautiful, ivory silk dress with decorative pearls and diamonds on it. I was amazed. I then made my way outside of the palace to explore some more. First I saw a huge multi-coloured bird sitting in a tree. It had a big beak and a feathered crest like that of a cockatoo. The bird spoke to me, saying, 'Peace be upon you.' I also saw a tree with gigantic multi-coloured flowers. I went over to that tree and felt that I could communicate with it. I then noticed the river with the two forks and I sat down near it. Suddenly, I was back on planet earth. I heard a thump, an impact sound coming from my chest. I sat up with my heart racing! I was sweating, feeling pain in my chest, and was gasping for air. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 2002 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Irregular heartbeats. Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant I clearly left my body and existed outside it. How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. This felt so unique and so real. Tthe things I saw were hard to interpret with our limited language and life. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Just before bedtime Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. This felt like I was in that garden for a full day. It also seemed like there was no time there because the day remained the same. It was unlike earth morning, afternoon, evening and nighttime daylight changes. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. my vision in my NDE experience was powerful. I was able to control my vision by zooming with my eyes far and wide. My eyes never felt tired. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. my hearing in my NDE was very sharp. I can hear very clearly. If I had to focus on the bird, I can hear that bird singing. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. I was put into a beautiful garden which had all the pleasures that the heart, eyes, ears and nose could ever desire. There was a pleasant fragrance that gaive me calmness and good feelings. This place I can only describe as paradise. I have no other words but 'awesome' and 'out of this world.' What emotions did you feel during the experience? I saw planets, stars and Galaxies go past me. I was in awe. I was calm and feltgood. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe. I saw the universe fly past me. I realized the earth is very tiny and we are so insignificant and so far away from that other great place. But we are not forgotten by God and we have a purpose in life. Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life. I requested to the Angel to speak to Allah. I told him that I must return back to my small children and my husband because they would need me. Then after some time I found myself back in my body with pain. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Muslim Practicing Sunni Muslim Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Muslim Practicing Sunni Muslim Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. This unearthly origin said he is an Angel of Almighty God (Allah). He was dressed in all white. His face was pale white and bright as the moon. He had his own light surrounding him like the color of moon light. His hair was silver colored and combed behind his head into a pony tail. He had blue eyes. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes I have no doubts that there is an Afterlife and that the other side does exist. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes when I asked that man who is he, he replied, 'I am an Angel and I was sent by Allah to take your soul because you are dead.' I requested that Angel to speak to Allah and to send me back to my small children and husband. I was sent back to my body which meant that Allah had listened to my request through that Angel. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes I am a Practicing Sunni Muslim. I keep up with prayer, give charity, Fast, and help people. I am not materialistic and know that I have a purpose in this life. During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists. I am 100% convinced there is life after death. I experienced that Angel and spoke to him with my brain., I saw that beautiful Garden with Palaces, rivers, streams and so on. I touched, felt, viewed, heard and toured. Earth could not compare to that place and it is a place that words cannot describe. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? Yes I realized that yes I will sacrifice that beautiful Garden for my children and husband and that leaving that Garden means that I will no doubt will go through hardships, difficulties and challenges. During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes I believe that I am loved and so I encountered that Angel who was not scary. He held my hand when he told me I am dead. He took me to that Garden that was Chosen by God and that I would remain there till Judgment day. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes This place I believe must be paradise. I cannot express my words, we on earth are so insignificant and so limited. That place I saw was very real from the trees to the palaces. I only explored a little, yet it blew my mind away of what I saw and felt. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. This is something I cannot forget because it is something I look forward to when I depart from this world. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Soon after I told my Husband, family and friends. They told me to keep up with the good work and that I am very lucky to had experienced this. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I believe this was real since I discussed it with that Angel. I questioned him and he answered me back. Then I encountered my Journey in the garden. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. I believe this was real and I look forward going back to that Journey. I am waiting for that Angel to receive me again when the time and destiny is right for me to go. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Initially scared; then sadness about leaving family that vanished as they moved upward.

arrival.other_being_detail: A man identified himself as “Allah’s Angel” and said he was sent to take her soul because she was dead.

environment.environment_other_detail: Garden with massive paths; sparkling white sand; blossoming trees producing musical melodies; flowers emitting their own light; peach-colored sky with no sun/moon/stars; river forking into milk-colored and honey-colored streams; huge palace with pearl domes and emerald doors; gems and glowing transparent bricks; perfect peaceful weather; pleasant fragrance.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Irregular heartbeats; not considered life-threatening by experiencer.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Rapid ascent through sky/space past planets, stars, and galaxies before arrival in garden.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in bedroom, then ascent through sky/space, then arrival in garden/palace environment; boundary statement at gate; later sudden return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Saw a “carbon copy” of herself sleeping beside her husband (interpreted by experiencer as possibly a jinn), while she perceived herself as the soul standing in the room. Also a speaking bird said, “Peace be upon you,” and she felt she could communicate with a tree.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I am Allah's Angel and I have been sent to take your soul because you are dead now.” / “You cannot leave this garden. This garden is your place and you have to stay here until Judgment Day.” / “This is my home.”
